sketches.intent: Contrast Glass Current: dry, fast, polyphonic/retriggered resonant reed-like lead for detached runs, stabs and dyads; no vibrato, legato glide or cyclic motion.

Contrast Pulse Lattice: sustained mono held-note bed with sixteenth amplitude pulses and dotted-eighth stepped cutoff, rather than short metallic MIDI plucks. Transport moves timbre; MIDI supplies pitch.
